requests.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Generate exactly ONE standalone 16:9 horizontal Chinese article illustration, ideally 1536x864 or 2048x1152. Pure #FFFFFF white background, abundant blank space (at least 45%), sparse slightly wobbly thin BLACK hand-drawn pen outlines, small restrained blue and orange annotations. Main subject centrally occupies 45%-55% of canvas with generous margins. No paper texture, no shadows, no gradients, no gray wash, no background scenery. This is an absurd but lucid editorial sketch, NOT a PPT infographic, formal flowchart, commercial vector illustration, cute mascot poster, children's drawing, realistic UI, or multi-panel collage. No heading, no title in top-left, no branding, no watermark.
XiaoM is the core active worker: small deadpan mushroom creature, rounded RED dome cap with 3-5 WHITE polka dots, CREAM stem body with black outlines, BLACK dot eyes, thin stick limbs, serious blank expression. Never solid black, never smiling or shiny-eyed. Flat red cap and cream stem, no 3D rendering. XiaoM must physically perform the conceptual action rather than stand watching. Only the exact short Chinese labels specified below, legible handwritten Simplified Chinese. Restrained orange for movement and blue for checks/system notes.
Anchor 1: computational research is an iterative feedback loop, not proof just because a program ran.
Invent a sparse low-tech scene: XiaoM sits astride a small almost-circular bent wire desk, actively erasing and revising a planning sheet with one hand while holding a returned numerical-results sheet up to a known reference curve with the other. A tiny simple code terminal (just black code marks, no readable UI) sits on the desk between planning and results. Three loose orange curved arrow strokes around the work connect plan -> execute -> check -> return to plan. The checking station clearly shows a blue reference curve and a black computed curve close but not identical, with a small ruler held by XiaoM; checking feeds revision rather than a success trophy. Tiny label near the planning sheet "方案", near terminal "执行", beside checking sheet "核验", and near returning arrow "修订". These FOUR labels only. Keep the three simple objects and single active XiaoM airy, large white holes between them; no extra equations or scientific claims.
